text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Walking near the school gates after school...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, class is over!
Time for karaokeâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, do you have a moment?
You... seem to be feeling unwell.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...No way~, that's not true at all!
I'm full of energy! Weeey!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...You can't fool me.
No going outside—let's get some proper rest."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Umm, but, like, you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Are you saying you have a reason
you absolutely must go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san really sees
right through everything, doesn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Actually, today's karaoke session was to cheer up
someone who lost her last race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's no good if everyone gets all gloomy, right?
That's why I want to go and liven things up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Then that makes it even worse.
What if you end up passing your illness to that child?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even if you feel fine now,
fevers often spike at night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Okaaay...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I will head over to the karaoke session and take full responsibility for hyping everyone up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san did?!
What the, I totally wanna see that!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Please just stay in bed and rest quietly.
Don't forget to stay hydrated, too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chills are a sign your fever is still rising, so make sure to keep yourself warm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Conversely, if your body heats up, wipe off the sweat first
and change into lighter clothing to let the heat escape."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan rattles off point after point,
leaving Mejiro Palmer completely rendered speechless.
Watching the two of them, you can't help but—
choice_data_list: You sure know how to handle this, Ardan.
You really know how to handle this, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan rattles off point after point,
leaving Mejiro Palmer completely rendered speechless.
Watching the two of them, you can't help but—
choice_data_list: You sure know how to handle this, Ardan.
You really know how to handle this, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you.
Perhaps it's simply because I have a bit more experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's not really something to boast about, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No way, not true at all! Having you teach me was a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Please don't hesitate to reach out anytime if you're not feeling well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thanks!!
I'll definitely outrun this illness!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Once you're all healed up, let's go to karaoke together
for a get-well celebration, Ardan-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's liven things up with everything we've got when the time comes.
I'll show you my absolute brightest radiance♪
